sig: [[["A", "Good morning, everyone. This is Karen Liu from Human Resources with a quick update on our employee benefits."], ["A", "Starting January first, we're expanding our parental leave program."], ["A", "All new parents, regardless of gender, will now receive sixteen weeks of fully paid leave, up from ten weeks."], ["A", "We're also launching a new wellness benefit."], ["A", "Every full-time employee will get a monthly allowance of fifty dollars to spend on gym memberships, fitness classes, or mental health apps."], ["A", "Part-time staff will receive half that amount, so twenty-five dollars a month."], ["A", "To use the allowance, simply keep your receipts and submit them through the HR portal by the last Friday of each month."], ["A", "We know you'll have questions, so we're holding two information sessions next week."], ["A", "The first one is on Tuesday at noon in the main cafeteria, and the second is on Thursday at four in Conference Room B."], ["A", "Lunch will be provided at the Tuesday session."], ["A", "Before then, please take a few minutes to read the benefits guide that we emailed this morning."], ["A", "If anything is unclear, feel free to reach out to me directly. Thanks, and have a great day."]], {"A": "F-US"}]
